title: Zuljanah Aye Zuljanah
body:
Zuljanah ay zuljanah
<<MINI>>
Boli khatun-e-jina, yani shabbir ki maa(n), mera bacha hai(n) kahaa(n)
Zuljana ay zuljana (mera bacha hai(n) kaha(n)) x2
Boli khatun-e-jina, yani shabbir ki maa(n), mera bacha hai(n) kahaa(n)
Zuljana ay zuljana (mera bacha hai(n) kaha(n)) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Lay gaya ghar se ek pyaase ko, Rab ke mehboob ke nawase ko, Chor ker
aagaya laeeno me, Gham zada maa ke tu assase ko. Dhund ne jawu(n) use, is andhere me kaha(n), Mera bachaa hai(n) kaha(n)
<<MINI>>
(Zuljana ay zuljana mera bacha hai(n) kaha(n)) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis ne lashe uthaye the din bhar, khune asghar tha jiske chehre par, zakhme akbar ki thi anni dil me, bhayi ki gham me jhuk gayi thi kamar, khaak urhaate hai nabi, hai ali mehve fughaa, mera bacha hai(n) kahaa(n)
<<MINI>>
Zuljana ay zuljana (mera bacha hai(n) kaha(n)) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
raqibe dosh mustafa tha wo, tujhko bachpan se chahata tha wo, saath
kyu(n) aaj uska chor diya, jabke mushkil me agaya tha wo, bewafayi ka
sabab, kya karu(n) tujhko bayaa(n), mera bacha hai(n) kahaa(n)
(Fatema zahra) x4
tere mathe pe khun hai kiska, rang khu(n) ye tere sawaar ka tha, hai
mere shir ki mehek usme, kampta hai alam se dil mera, bol khamosh hai kyu(n), tere asu(n) hai rawaa, mera bacha hai(n) kahaa(n)
<<MINI>>
Zuljana ay zuljana (mera bacha hai(n) kaha(n)) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
jo teri pyaas par udaas raha, ho ke
paani ki aaspaas raha, phir bhi paani piyaa nahi usne, teri khatir wo
mehwe yaas raha, khushk tha uska ghala, khushk thi uski zabaa(n), mera
bacha hai(n) kahaa(n)
<<MINI>>
Zuljana ay zuljana (mera bacha hai(n) kaha(n)) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise soyegi ladli uski, jisko sine pa neend aati thi, jisne roka
tha tujhko jaate huwe, kya kahega agar wo puchhegi, samna uska na kar, roke dedegi wo jaa(n), mera bacha hai(n) kahaa(n)
<<MINI>>
Zuljana ay zuljana (mera bacha hai(n) kaha(n)) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
qalb zainab kahee(n) fighar na ho, dilpe ehle haram ke waar na ho, tu jo khayme me jayenga khali, kon hai jo, ke soghwaar na ho, tu jo
jaayega wahaa(n), hashr ka honga samaa(n), mera bacha hai(n) kahaa(n)
<<MINI>>
Zuljana ay zuljana (mera bacha hai(n) kaha(n)) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
na gawaa sar sina pe aayaa nazar, zikre khaliq tha jiske honto par, thaam kar dil larazte haatho(n) se, boli "rehan", madare sarwar, tujhse
ay aspe jhari, ab na puchengi ye maa(n), mera bachha hai kahaa(n), Zuljana ay zuljana (mera bacha hai(n) kaha(n)) x2
(Fatema zehra) x4
Meera vad maula, sarwar-e-zehra, aho-wawayla
